tiles.name: datamesh
tiles.seam: bars split exactly at the top/bottom edge; columns at (k+0.5)*240/39
tiles.source: statistics of the data mesh in original 02 (pitch, bar width, run/gap lengths, segments per run, tone shares, coverage)

tiles.name: halftone
tiles.seam: dots stay inside the tile (centres >= 3 px from the edges, r <= 3); fade is periodic in x+y

tiles.name: ap-monogram
tiles.seam: staggered lattice (80 x 60 px, rows offset 40) shifted a quarter step; every monogram lies inside the tile

tiles.name: facets
tiles.seam: periodic jittered 8x8 vertex lattice; facets of the neighbouring periods are clipped exactly to the tile

stats.shading: flat-shaded relief (vertex heights +-14 px, light from top-left) + periodic diagonal band (0.3), quantised to the ramp

tiles.name: ribbon-lines
tiles.seam: cosine period = 240 (flush butt ends at x=0/240); lines near the top/bottom edge are repeated one tile up/down (opaque, so overlaps are invisible); clip to the 240x240 tile

notes: Background is the first <rect id='bg'> of each tile. Make an Illustrator pattern with tile size 240x240 (Pattern Options, Size Tile to Art off).
